definitions.explanation: Manual labor involved in farming, such as planting, harvesting, weeding, and tending crops. Refers to the physical tasks of agriculture rather than farm management.

notes:
{農作業|のうさぎょう} refers to the hands-on physical tasks of farming — planting, weeding, harvesting, and tending crops.
